688:t_3:186.en:
$$カレン$$
「Then we'll take care of both shares at once!」

688:t_3:190.en:
$$ハレルヤ$$
「Sorry, $$アレルヤ$$! This one's my turn!」

688:t_3:191.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Then I'll represent the $$エレメント$$s!!」

688:t_3:192.en:
$$アポロ$$
「I'm counting on you to take care of ours, $$シルヴィア$$.」

688:t_3:194.en:
$$赤木$$
「Let's do it, $$シンジ$$! One punch, no hard feelings afterward, and we end it!」

688:t_3:196.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'm leaving it to you, $$ブレラ$$.」

688:t_3:197.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Then I'll go with output at maximum.」

688:t_3:201.en:
$$宗介$$
「Time to wrap this up, I suppose.」

688:t_3:204.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「H-hey, wait! An Armor Magnum is really out of the question!」

688:t_3:206.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「J-joking...?! Your opponent is $$キリコ$$, you know!」

688:t_3:207.en:
$$キリコ$$
「If I'd meant to kill you, I'd have done it from the start.」

688:t_3:208.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You pulled a trick like $$バインドスペル$$ on us. I'm taking at least this much.」

688:t_3:209.en:
$$ランド$$
「Oh boy... your prized exterior is all banged up. I'll fix it for you later.」

688:t_3:211.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I have plenty I'd like to say. But for now, let's move forward.」

688:t_3:212.en:
$$バナージ$$
「At the very least, we feel the same way about wanting to defeat the $$御使い$$s.」

688:t_3:213.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「But if you ever betray us...」

688:t_3:214.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Then be prepared for the consequences.」

688:t_3:215.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I-I understand, so please, $$正太郎$$! Put the $$Ｖコン$$ down!」

688:t_3:216.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Let me be clear: this is strictly an emergency measure until the $$御使い$$s are defeated. As for what comes after, we will set up a proper forum for discussion.」

688:t_3:217.en:
$$桂$$
「For now, keep the AG Mask on. At least that way we can talk without any unnecessary preconceptions.」

688:t_3:218.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... that's fine with me. I... rather liked that position.」

688:t_3:219.en:
$$勝平$$
「He hasn't shown one bit of remorse!」

688:t_3:220.en:
$$万丈$$
「It's pointless to demand that sort of thing from him.」

688:t_3:221.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Let's hope Representative $$エルガン#pilot$$, who is inside him, acts as his brake.」

688:t_3:222.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Even so, we have a common enemy in the $$御使い$$s.」

688:t_3:223.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「To fight such a powerful enemy, we may have to accept the clean with the dirty.」

688:t_3:224.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Joining forces even with former enemies - truly befitting those who have touched the cosmic truth of living together.」

688:t_3:225.en:
$$セツコ$$
「What am I to do with you...」

688:t_3:226.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't get carried away, $$ＡＧ$$. For the sake of living, we're not about to let villains off the hook, either.」

688:t_3:228.en:
$$トライア$$
「There's no time left to spare, either. First we have to move forward.」

688:t_3:229.en:
$$エスター$$
「That's easy to say, but where should we head?」

688:t_3:230.en:
$$トライア$$
「The $$御使い$$s are probably keeping track of our movements through the $$烙印$$ they carved themselves.」

688:t_3:231.en:
$$トライア$$
「Conversely, if we trace it, we should reach where they are.」

688:t_3:232.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「Is something like that possible?」

688:t_3:233.en:
$$トライア$$
「Until now it was only theory, but in this $$カオス・コスモス$$ it should be possible.」

688:t_3:234.en:
$$トライア$$
「After all, this is a universe where perception born of will holds power. What those guys are after takes on a much clearer form.」

688:t_3:235.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「A universe where perception holds power... huh.」

688:t_3:236.en:
$$シモン$$
「So that's why $$真化融合$$ and Tengen Toppa were possible.」

688:t_3:237.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Then surely we'll meet her, too...」

688:t_3:239.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「Is there someone you know in this universe?」

688:t_3:240.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Joy, anger, sorrow, pleasure... The last one remaining of the four $$御使い$$s...」

688:t_3:241.en:
$$セツコ$$
「The woman I sensed when we were transferred to the $$カオス・コスモス$$ before...」

688:t_3:243.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I think she's the $$御使い$$ who governs sorrow.」

688:t_3:244.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The only one among them who helps us...」

688:t_3:246.en:
$n
「...Even so, I will not fall into despair...」

688:t_3:247.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Now that's a warrior who has transcended hope and despair! Infinite possibilities beyond even my calculations and expectations!」

688:t_3:250.en:
$$宗介$$
「I had heard the rumors, but the unpleasantness of this man... is intolerable.」

688:t_3:251.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Y-yeah... He's just creepy, no matter how you look at it...」

688:t_3:252.en:
$$テッサ$$
「To think a person like this was hiding inside $c...」

688:t_3:253.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Not thinking of people as people... that's no different from the $$御使い$$s!」

688:t_3:254.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「W-wait! If we just talk, you'll understand!」

688:t_3:255.en:
$$レド$$
「Don't expect anyone to trust a man who secretly planted suggestions akin to mind control.」

688:t_3:256.en:
$$カレン$$
「Representative $$エルガン#pilot$$ is just as bad! Letting a guy like this talk him around!」

688:t_3:257.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「I apologize for going ahead without telling you. And for my methods as well.」

688:t_3:258.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Come to think of it, you... were like this back in the $$破界事変$$ too.」

688:t_3:259.en:
$$シモン$$
「If you think anything is allowed as long as the goal is right, you are dead wrong.」

688:t_3:260.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「I will make no excuses. But I want you to know this, at least.」

688:t_3:261.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「It is a fact that every one of $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル|lc$$s, myself and $$ジエー・ベイベル$$ included, is working to overthrow the $$御使い$$s.」

688:t_3:262.en:
$n
「The names of $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$'s weapons... and $$スヴェル$$, too... So what you want is the Ragnarok of Norse mythology...」

688:t_3:263.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「That's the occult maniac for you! You really get it!」

688:t_3:264.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Before that lofty goal, $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル|lc$$s have become one like this, beyond position, methods and personality.」

kept_omissions: 688:t_3:186: 'both shares' - 二人分 not attributed (Zero left his share to Kallen and Suzaku; unclear whose two shares).
688:t_3:187: 'Nono, Lal'C!' - bare call, no verb added.
688:t_3:206: 'Your opponent is Chirico' - 相手 kept literal; scene implies Chirico would be the one firing the Armor Magnum.
688:t_3:209: addressee of the repair line left as 'your prized exterior' (AG, who answers 'Everyone...').
688:t_3:225: 'What am I to do with you...' - Setsuko's あなたという人は… kept open, addressed to AG.
688:t_3:255: subject of 'Don't expect anyone to trust...' kept impersonal (Ledo, addressee unclear).
uncertain: Edel's speaker line uses the #pilot variant; his 'nya' (にゃ) rendered 'nya' in 254/263/264 (Mari precedent) - not settled by the style guide.

AG and The Edel are apparently the same person in an AG mask in this scene (AG is gendered he/him by Banjo, Kappei, Jeffrey); I used he/him for AG/Edel in 219/220/221/251/253 and 'the Edel' pronouns, following Banjo's 彼.
188 了解だ = 'Understood!'; 202 kept existing 'Mission understood.' although 'Mission accepted' is Heero's usual phrase.
186 二人分 and 206 相手は interpretations (see kept_omissions).
223 清濁併せ呑む = 'accept the clean with the dirty' (idiom, freely rendered).
認識 rendered 'perception' (233/234/235); 烙印（スティグマ）: bracketed gloss dropped, token $$烙印$$ ('Stigma') used.
天元突破 (236) left as plain 'Tengen Toppa' (no bare glossary token); 真化融合 uses keyword token $$真化融合$$.
209: 自慢の外装 taken as AG's exterior (AG is a robot/mask); could be something else.
Kamille's 204-206 Armor Magnum joke: AG speaker 'Chirico' honorific 様 dropped per rules.
